name: Turn Artillery
hook: Lob shells over the hills. Mind the wind.
how: Take turns: drive a little, aim, pick your power and fire. The wind changes every turn and every shell digs a crater, so the hills change too. Last tank standing wins; after a while the water starts to rise.
controls: Drag from your tank to aim and let go to fire, or arrow keys and hold Space
uses: The players with the most match wins.
The host's browser checks each shot, works out where it lands and the damage, and runs the turns; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots take the empty tanks and aim with a little error, so you can play alone.
Everyone sees the same hills, the same shell and the same craters.
ideas: Add a cluster shell that splits into three
Let each player have a team of three tanks
Make it on the moon with low gravity
